flags: The former tagline assigns all 54 miles to the bridge-to-Capitol segment. The cache supports 54 miles for the full trail/byway, including Selma streets, but does not establish that precise segment length. Rephrased.
Alabama Byways contains internal inconsistencies in march crowd counts and chronology. Used the Capitol and march articles for March 25 and 25,000; omitted the conflicting nearly 30,000 figure.
The Capitol article and the march article disagree over whether a secretary ultimately accepted the petition and over the sequence surrounding the speech. Omitted petition delivery.

The trail article mixes the 2015 Marion connecting trail with the original 54-mile corridor and calls the designation National Scenic Byway. Used FHWA’s precise All-American Road designation and kept this drive Selma to Montgomery.

Lowndes voting-registration figures and the 1965 lane restriction are supported by the cached march article, but no underlying county rolls or court order is saved. These consequential details warrant primary-source follow-up before publication.
